text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Today's 1,400-meter scrimmage has
begun! All eyes are on Hishi
Akebono and
Biko Pegasus!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bono, you're really on fire today, huh?
Weeell, so am I!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono soars down the course with
explosive speed. No one
would believe me
if I told them about the day before.

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono's the big racer over there,
right? She always makes the
tastiest food
for everyone at the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's her! I knew she was huge, but
next to Biko Pegasus, her
size is extra
obvious!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
All right, the racers have entered the
homestretch! In the lead is Hishi Akebono,
followed closely by Biko Pegasus! Will
Hishi Akebono outrun her, or will she be
overtaken?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
(Huh? Why do my legs feel so heavy... Ah,
right, I didn't get much
sleep last night.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's it all right. But so what?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono's eyes sparkle as she locks
eyes with the path ahead
of her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, everybody, I'm giving this
race everything I got!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And no one can overtake me when I give
100%!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
First to cross the finish line is Hishi
Akebono! Hishi Akebono is our
winner!
She managed to inch ahead for a narrow
victory!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Yippee!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Racer
text_block_list.text: You really are a force to be reckoned with on the track, Bono. You're such a gentle giant, I sometimes forget the giant part.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Well, it's a race, right? No way I
could smile after a race where
I didn't give
it my all. Isn't that right, Biko? ♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
I know I'm in for a real fight
when you're in the roster!
...But losing still
hurts!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Next time,
victory will be mine! I swear it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! I thought you left to rest.
You
didn't have to come, but
well, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Likewise,
I'd like her to rest after this race
and the day we had
yesterday, but before
I can convey that thought...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me! I'm having a chanko
party after this! Would you like
to join
us? ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Come and get it, everybodyyy! I promise
the flavor is super-duper
buono. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After witnessing how Hishi Akebono flitted about the kitchen just now, I seriously wonder if her energy has any limit. Lured by the aroma, students steadily file into the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That means you too, Trainer! I made more
than enough, so be sure to
eat your fill.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: YUM! I could eat this all day!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ooh, you added ginger and perilla leaves to the fish balls... And it's real good. I'm stealin' that idea!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Seein' y'all sittin' 'round the table and
laughin' reminds me of home!
This meal's
delicious!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I-it really is...
And the vegetables you used
are so hard to come by.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Phew, everyone's got a bowl, right? Then
it's my turn to dig iiiin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking down at my bowl, I recognize
some vegetables inside. They
look just like
the ones I dropped in the river...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! Freshly picked veggies really do
make the best stew.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I sure did. I mean,
the whole reason
we were collecting
ingredients yesterday
was for this party.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
After all, I wanted to give my friends a
super-duper scrumptious bowl
of chanko
after a race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Why? Because after giving your all, you've
gotta eat buono food with
your friends!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Tracen is just like a sumo dojo,
Trainer! We
only get stronger when we
compete with
everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking past Hishi Akebono, I notice the
content faces of each of her
classmates as
they chow down on their chanko.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Arrrgh! I was right theeere!
A little more,
and I would've won!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't get too down on yourself. You
showed some real guts out there.
How
about doing some stamina training with
me?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think 'bout it, you've been
really goin' at it in the
mornings, Suzuka.
How far are you runnin' these days?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ummm... To the closest mountain...
I think.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ I'm glad everyone's having a good
time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to be there for her rivals—not
just as fierce competition,
but as a fellow
racer to grow alongside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just like her, her ambitions are big and
good-natured.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end though, there can be only one
winner. There may come a
time when her
ideals block her way forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
More and more students stop by the hot
pot party, and the festive
atmosphere
continues until right before curfew.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Trainer, what's wrong? You're
really spacing out today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where did that come from?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as Hishi Akebono desired, all the
students who came to the hot
pot party
left with a smile and a full belly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If anyone can become a pot of chanko and
bring a smile of
satisfaction to everyone
else... it's her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono's big, bright eyes grow
even bigger as I continue.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Okay! Thank you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! As thanks for tagging
along with me yesterday, I
baked you
some cookies!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I baked them with lots and lots of
love, so
I can promise a buono
taste! ♪ Say "ah"!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I steel my resolve to make her dreams
come true, starting with her
debut, I take a
bite. My mouth fills with a soft, sweet
warmth...
